same_actual_objects: K is n04bActualTypedAtlas built from the given unchanged hT/hS/Through03/field/e witnesses.
K.cell is exactly n04CellAt at the actual reference negative half midpoint; it is not replaced by C.cell or the containing host.
All estimates use T.sample(K.cell k), the original material weights and the original closed negative component.
proved: The exact stored sample is at one uniformly bounded endpointX distance from every point of either closed negative component half, including the actual root and cut.
Every fixed real H/M power and nonnegative E0 power transfers from such a point to the same stored sample with an E0 power evaluated at that sample.
The actual point-to-sample H normalizer and any nonnegative sample E0 power have pointwise E0 polynomial bounds.
scope_limits: No final primitive or reference-jet certificate is an input.
No whole-positive or whole-negative membership in this stored cell is asserted.
No high-order spatial sample/reference jet bound or converse positive-component endpoint bound is asserted.
No material floor E0>=1, new Gamma, new optical lower bound or changed sample is introduced.
